title: Blade Runner 2049
feeling: loved
tags: [nocturnal, lonely, neon]
---
the rain never stops in this city. neon signs bleed across wet streets and
everything hums with a cold electric loneliness. K moves through the dark
alone, surrounded by millions yet utterly isolated — the silence between the
downpours says more than any line of dialogue. it is the exact night-time
feeling i keep chasing: beautiful and alone at the same time, the glow of the
city at 3am when no one else is awake.
